decisions.rationale: Disseminated Superficial Actinic Porokeratosis (DSAP) is a related condition, but the specific characteristics of the case are more closely aligned with EPPP.
Linear Porokeratosis is a distinct condition that does not match the clinical presentation and histopathological findings of the case.
Disseminated Superficial Porokeratosis (DSP) is a related condition, but the specific characteristics of the case are more closely aligned with EPPP.
